title: Ketchup, coffee pots, and Mare!
overview: Tine, a mafia hitman, comes home from a successfully completed job and can hardly wait to relax in a warm bath with a good pizza. But the evening doesn't exactly go according to plan.  MUVIT/6x60 is a film marathon where teams shoot a film in 60 hours according to given guidelines. GUIDELINES 2025 OBJECT: Crown SENTENCE: "What do you know, the last time you were home was for Christmas" ACTION: Confrontation (New) FILM CHARACTER: Teacher
